statement_scope.model: noiseless in-context linear regression in Equation (7)
statement_scope.quantifiers: for every epsilon>0 exists L(epsilon), for every L>=L(epsilon)

infinite_prompt_proof.risk_reduction: R_infinity(A,b)=1/2 tr((b Sigma A-I) Sigma (b Sigma A-I)^T)

gradient_flow.b_dot: tr(A^T Sigma^2)-b tr(A^T Sigma^2 A Sigma)

infinite_prompt_proof.positive_scalar: b(0)>0 and b cannot cross zero because balancedness would force A=0; ODE uniqueness would then contradict nonzero initialization
infinite_prompt_proof.boundedness: the loss sublevel and lambda_min(Sigma)>0 bound b and A on the balanced manifold
infinite_prompt_proof.stationary_dichotomy: on the balanced manifold every stationary point is either (A,b)=(0,0) or b A Sigma=I, hence A=b^-1 Sigma^-1 and b Sigma A=I

origin_exclusion.positive_diagonal: a_ii(0)>=0 and at least one is positive; zero has strictly positive inward derivative
origin_exclusion.trace_derivative: tr(A)_dot=b sum_i s_i^2-b^2 sum_i s_i^3 a_ii
origin_exclusion.near_origin_sign: if b^2<sum_i s_i^2/(2 sum_i s_i^3), then tr(A)_dot>=(b/2)sum_i s_i^2>0
origin_exclusion.conclusion: positive tr(A) cannot converge to zero while eventually increasing

infinite_prompt_proof.analytic_gradient_convergence: a bounded trajectory of this real-analytic gradient system converges to a stationary point
infinite_prompt_proof.initialization_domain: every alpha>0 and every P=Theta Theta^T with ||P||_F=1; stronger than the displayed alpha interval

transfer_scale_proof.query_normalization: write x_query=tau*g and replace U by tau*U inside each bounded-parameter concentration estimate
transfer_scale_proof.moment_condition: all polynomial moments of sigma_w are finite because ||w||_2^2 is chi-square_d
transfer_scale_proof.rate_condition: split chi-square_d at sqrt(ln L); both the bounded part and tail are o(ln(L)^-4), so ln(L)^4 E[L^(-c/sigma_w^2)]->0
transfer_scale_proof.tilted_moments: Gaussian exponential tilting gives N(Gamma_w U z,Gamma_w); on bounded U its required moments are polynomially bounded by tau and sigma_w
transfer_scale_proof.conclusion: the finite/infinite risk and gradient gaps used by Theorem 4.3 vanish for every fixed positive-definite Sigma; unit scale changes constants only

block_algebra: V* Gamma_w U*(x,0) has last coordinate w^T x
bayes_certificate.bayes_optimality: squared loss is nonnegative, so the attained zero risk is Bayes optimal

negative_control.result: the balance-based stationary dichotomy is unavailable

limitations: The certificate proves the exact population-gradient-flow theorem. It does not provide a numerical value of L(epsilon), which the paper also states only existentially.
